description: The man wears a long dark blue wool coat with tan-gold geometric woven borders along both open front edges, cuffs and below-knee hem. Narrow brown fur trim lines the opening, cuffs and bottom edge. A cream tunic underneath has a raised embroidered collar, blue patterned upper opening, central decoration and cuffs. A decorated dark leather belt holds the waist, with a long blue woven fringed strap and small gold fittings below it. Dark brown trousers tuck into tall dark leather boots with narrow woven decoration near the tops. All layers are opaque; his head and hands are bare.
